title: Years of Apple Health workouts turned into a dashboard and plain-English Q&A
summary: Phil Simon found Strava and Apple Health too thin for his questions, so he exported his Apple Health XML and had Claude Code convert it to CSV, compute summary stats and build an interactive dashboard.
agent_role: Claude Code wrote and ran the parsing script, produced statistics and built the dashboard; Simon posed the questions, such as how his HIIT calorie burn changed over the years.

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
